paper_title: Results from the Solar Hidden Photon Search (SHIPS)
notes: Solar hidden photon helioscope (TSHIPS). Constrains kinetic mixing chi vs HP mass (Fig. 13). This is a solar-flux helioscope, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies. Exclusion curve is bathtub-shaped, best sensitivity chi ~ 3e-8 around m ~ 3e-3 to 3e-2 eV; data points read approximately from Fig. 13 (95% C.L.). Values are absolute chi.
